# confirm / prompt — shared: confirm / prompt of shared/utils.js
# a fresh page per case; #opener has focus when the dialog opens. "after 60 s" is the
# fake clock moved a minute on: a dialog still pending then never resolves by itself.

## confirm
confirm(msg): the DOM it writes: focus #opener
    div class="confirm-overlay modal-overlay active"
      div class="confirm-box modal"
        html "<p>Delete &lt;b&gt;BIN-1&lt;/b&gt; &amp; &quot;its&quot; tags?</p>"
        button class="btn" listens=click
          "Cancel"
        button class="btn btn-danger" listens=click
          "Confirm"
confirm: OK: resolves true, no overlay left, focus #opener
confirm: Cancel: resolves false, no overlay left, focus #opener
confirm: Escape on body, after 60 s: pending, 1 overlay(s) left: "confirm-overlay modal-overlay active"
confirm: Escape on its OK button, after 60 s: pending, 1 overlay(s) left: "confirm-overlay modal-overlay active"
confirm: the page opened and hid a modal with this surface's showModal first, then Escape on body, after 60 s: pending, 1 overlay(s) left: "confirm-overlay modal-overlay"
confirm: press and click the overlay (backdrop), after 60 s: pending, 1 overlay(s) left: "confirm-overlay modal-overlay active"
confirm: a second one opened while the first is open: 2 overlays; OK on the second: first pending, second resolves true; then Cancel on the first: first resolves false, no overlay left
confirm: OK clicked twice: resolves true, no overlay left
confirm(non-string message 42): the message node:
    html "<p>42</p>"

## prompt
prompt(msg): the DOM it writes, focus after a tick: focus at open #opener, after a tick input.form-input
    div class="confirm-overlay modal-overlay active"
      div class="confirm-box modal"
        html "<p>Delete &lt;b&gt;BIN-1&lt;/b&gt; &amp; &quot;its&quot; tags?</p>"
        input class="form-input" type="text" value="" listens=keydown
        button class="btn" listens=click
          "Cancel"
        button class="btn btn-primary" listens=click
          "OK"
prompt(msg, {type:"number", min:1, max:9, value:5}): the input: type "number", min "1", max "9", value "5"
prompt(msg, {type:"date"}): the input type: "text"
prompt: OK untouched, no default: resolves "", no overlay left, focus body
prompt: OK untouched, {value:"5"}: resolves "5"
prompt: OK untouched, {value:0}: resolves "0"
prompt: {value:"5"}, cleared to empty, OK: resolves ""
prompt: typed "abc", OK: resolves "abc"
prompt: typed "abc", Enter in the input: resolves "abc", no overlay left
prompt: typed "abc", Escape in the input: resolves null, no overlay left
prompt: typed "abc", Cancel: resolves null, no overlay left
prompt: Escape on body, after 60 s: pending, 1 overlay(s) left: "confirm-overlay modal-overlay active"
prompt: press and click the overlay (backdrop), after 60 s: pending, 1 overlay(s) left: "confirm-overlay modal-overlay active"
prompt: over an open modal (this surface's showModal), Escape in the input: resolves null, the modal underneath closed
prompt: a second one opened while the first is open: 2 overlays, focus input.form-input in overlay 2; Enter in the first: first resolves "one", second pending, 1 overlay(s) left: "confirm-overlay modal-overlay active"
